snippet.title: Draught King - Announcement Trailer - Playtest Now Available!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5390400/Draught_King/

Draught King is the world's first pub-like, a deckbuilder roguelike where you serve ingredient cards to make drinks and build crazy combos. Our Playtest is now available, try it out! 

With over 200 special coasters to influence your score, a dozen playable bartenders, 300 ingredients, 50+ bosses, and 15 difficulty levels, there is a ton of content to keep you busy on becoming the world's best bartender.

We now have a playtest live through Steam and would love you to join us in testing the game!
